implemented_guards: PRE event binding must be exact Day1 with race_date and venue
PRE capture timestamp must precede the bound PIT cutoff
official same-race assignment status must be exact-pass and captured before the same cutoff
assignment expected event must match PRE event
observed same-race exact-match flag must be true when emitted
official registration number must be six digits and can be externally bound
PRE and assignment source SHA256 values are mandatory
PRE and assignment PIT cutoff values must match exactly
explicit_boundary: The validator joins already-captured PRE evidence and official same-race assignment evidence. It does not create either source, does not reconstruct PRE after cutoff, does not guess race IDs, and does not authorize support by itself. A PASS record is only ready for the duplicate-safe receipt guard/builder layer.
